verdict.rationale: Temporal documents first-party SDK development paths: a TypeScript developer guide with a dedicated testing suite, a Python integration with the OpenAI Agents SDK, and Python AI cookbook recipes. These sit on core client operations (start, query, signal workflows). Community users confirm building with Temporal's cross-language libraries, and one reports a library bug being fixed by the team within a day. Missing for 10: an explicit inventory of the officially supported language SDKs (beyond TypeScript and Python as evidenced), SDK API reference documentation, and an SDK versioning or support policy.
